about: [C11 after the critic] the critic's finding 8 (from the code): is the office's desk lamp put out by a round into it, or by one into the bare ceiling above the desk? In the loud pass, by real input: into the office, a round at the desk lamp's bulb, then one at the ceiling point the lamp's registry still names as its head.

steps.look: (() => { const K = G.controller, e = G.camera.position; const tx = G.stage.lamps.lamps.find((l) => l.tag === 'office').light.pos.x, ty = G.stage.lamps.lamps.find((l) => l.tag === 'office').light.pos.y, tz = G.stage.lamps.lamps.find((l) => l.tag === 'office').light.pos.z; const want = Math.atan2(-(tx - e.x), -(tz - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - K.yaw), Math.cos(want - K.yaw)); const pit = Math.atan2(ty - e.y, Math.hypot(tx - e.x, tz - e.z)); return [Math.round(-dy / K.sensitivity), Math.round((K.pitch - pit) / K.sensitivity)]; })()
